title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Gamble Pharaoh's Servant PSV-053 Common / Short Print Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card is a 1st edition, common rarity, trap-normal card named Gamble from the Pharaoh's Servant set. The card number is PSV-053 and it is manufactured by Konami. It is a great addition to any collector's or player's deck. The card features a trap attribute and is perfect for those who enjoy playing the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG game.
